findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: close_lookup · Private data: lookup_error, close_lookup · Public sink: session_brief · Destructive: session_brief.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: close_lookup · Private data: lookup_error, close_lookup · Public sink: session_brief · Destructive: session_brief

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "session_brief" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
